services.name: Guided Tours
services.desc: Venture into the depths of the earth with a tour through Coral Caverns in Bedford County, PA. You don't have to be a geologist to appreciate the marvels hidden within the earth's crust. This geological wonder is the only known cave in the world with a vertical fossilized coral reef. The caverns house a labyrinth of passages, lending a surreal feeling to the tours. This feeling is amplified when viewing fossils that have traveled hundreds of miles over millions of years. All in all, the Coral Caverns are a fascinating peek at what lies beneath our feet. Coral Caverns is only a short drive for campers at Nature's Gateway RV Park & Campground, offering an ideal day trip to explore the area.
